d.ko: Live life on the tracks and discover the joy of train simulation. Whether looking for a relaxing run on the rails or seeking the thrill of mastering your virtual train driver career, find your way in Train Sim World 7.
d.en: Live life on the tracks and discover the joy of train simulation. Whether looking for a relaxing run on the rails or seeking the thrill of mastering your virtual train driver career, find your way in Train Sim World 7.
d.zh: 体验铁路上的生活，发现火车模拟的乐趣。无论你是想在铁轨上休闲驰骋，还是想体验掌握虚拟火车驾驶员职业生涯的刺激，都可以在《模拟火车世界7》中找到适合自己的玩法。
